title: Scalar action unitor for a normalized signed tensor comparison
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and W a scheme. On the ringed quotient sequence site of [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], let T be the signed direct-sum total tensor [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] and let S be termwise scalar extension for the identity E-algebra map. Let U:S ≅ Id be the action unitor fixed on every section by a tensor x ↦ a*x. Suppose sigma:T ⋙ S ≅ (S.prod S) ⋙ T is a natural isomorphism sending 1 tensor (x tensor y), in every homogeneous summand, to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). Then sigma followed by T(U,U) equals U evaluated on T, as natural isomorphisms on cochain complexes. There are no boundedness or flatness assumptions.

source.place: Integral-operations clause; parent lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence proof step 7. Ordinary action-unitor calculation: Stacks 03EL, totalization: Stacks 07A4.

proof.text: Precompose with the inverse action unitor on the total tensor. On every homogeneous pure tensor its section formula inserts the scalar one. The normalization of sigma and the action formulas for the two unitors show that the composite fixes this tensor.

The tensor functor is natural on the sheafification-unit pairing. Sectionwise pure tensors generate the tensor presheaf, the sheafification adjunction detects equality of its maps to a sheaf, and the coproduct inclusions detect equality on the signed total. Chain-map and natural-transformation extensionality give equality after precomposition. Cancel the invertible unitor.
